Files removed from this directory after it was first committed.

FETCHED_AT, fetch.log and urls.txt are kept unchanged as the record of the
ttl/ fetch.

2026-11-21  Removed llms.txt (decision: docs/decisions.md ADR-018).
            It was not part of the ttl/ fetch: it is not in urls.txt,
            fetch.log or SHA256SUMS. It was committed with this directory in
            e7c4119 and held the text of https://meta.linked.archi/llms.txt.
            It carries no license statement, has no entry in ttl/catalog.ttl,
            and nothing in AISEP (module manifests, code, models, tests, docs)
            references it.

2026-11-21  Removed ttl/archimate3_onto.ttl, ttl/archimate3_onto_3.0.ttl and
            ttl/archimate3_onto_3.1.ttl, and removed every skos:definition and
            skos:scopeNote statement (176) from ttl/archimate4_onto.ttl
            (decision: Albert, 2026-11-21, recorded in the PR that made this
            change). Their definition and scope-note text is largely
            word-for-word text of the ArchiMate Specification, copyright The
            Open Group, which the CC BY licenses declared in these files cannot
            cover: about two thirds of the removed words of archimate4_onto.ttl,
            and 33-93% of the text of the three archimate3_onto files, match the
            ArchiMate 3.1 Specification verbatim. The three archimate3_onto
            files are not loaded by AISEP. In archimate4_onto.ttl nothing else
            changed: parsed as RDF, the new file is the old one minus exactly
            those 176 triples. SHA256SUMS lists the modified file's new hash
            and no longer lists the removed files.
